section_summary.extract_value: This section details the experimental manipulations used in the study, focusing on goal frame, goal content, and goal proximity. Trainees were induced with either a learning or performance orientation through instructions and specific goals. Performance instructions emphasized demonstrating competence and avoiding mistakes, while learning instructions focused on skill development and task mastery. Goals were also manipulated as either proximal (new goals before each block) or distal (same terminal goals across blocks).
